verdict.rationale: Cake documents a 409A valuation included in the cap table plan, done by expert startup appraisers and delivered within 3 business days, and lists it as a plan feature on its pricing page. The evidence does not show the valuation being generated from live cap table data, explicitly audit-ready or safe-harbor documentation, or any recurring refresh schedule; it describes a one-off deliverable, not ongoing scheduled valuations. Missing for 10: evidence the valuation draws on live cap table data, explicit audit-ready/safe-harbor documentation, scheduled or recurring refreshes, details of the in-platform ordering workflow, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can order an audit-ready 409A valuation in-platform, generated from my live cap table data, and get refreshed valuations on schedule

citations.quote: 409A included in your cap table plan, done by expert startup appraisers, delivered within 3 business days.
